 Ahn Bo-hyun, Claudia Kim coming to Manila for 'Sacred Jewel' premiere
 Jaehwa Bernardo ,
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 18, 2026 04:36 PM PHT 
 Ahn Bo-hyun, left, and Claudia Kim.  Photo from Prime Video Philippines on Instagram South Korean actors Ahn Bo-hyun and Claudia Kim are visiting Manila in December for the premiere of their new drama "Sacred Jewel."
 Prime Video Philippines, where the historical drama will stream, announced Wednesday the event in an Instagram post.
 "Ahn Bo-hyun and Claudia Kim are headed to Manila for a special #SacredJewelOnPrime premiere event on December 5," Prime Video wrote in the post's caption.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Prime Video PH (@primevideoph) The streamer, however, said the premiere was "a closed event for invited guests only," adding that more details were "coming soon."
 ADVERTISEMENT
 Historical K-drama starring Ahn Bo-hyun, Claudia Kim gets Dec. 5 premiere Set in 1258, during Korea's Goryeo Dynasty, "Sacred Jewel" follows a warrior who leads an expedition to retrieve a precious jewel believed to hold the power to protect the kingdom from the Mongols.
 Bo-hyun, who held a fan meeting in Manila in 2024, is known for starring in dramas such as "Itaewon Class," "Yumi's Cells," "Military Prosecutor Doberman," "See You in My 19th Life," "Flex X Cop" and "Spring Fever."
 READ: Ahn Bo-hyun, Lee Joo-been hope ‘Spring Fever’ delivers healing experience
 Meanwhile, Claudia Kim is known for appearing in Hollywood films such as "Avengers: Age of Ultron" and "Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald," as well as K-dramas like "Gyeongseong Creature" and "The Atypical Family."
